column1: # Readings use the app's convention: dh = th in "this", gh = soft g, h = Bulgarian х, y = й; the accent marks the stress.

column7: To several people, or politely: γεια σας (ya sas).
Careful: it sounds like Bulgarian "не" (no), but means yes.
The Greek question mark is ; (it looks like a semicolon).
When parting after meeting someone: χάρηκα (hárika), "it was nice meeting you".
